findings.issue: The 'Request a quote for watersports apparel' button sits only a few pixels above the tinted trustBar band. The plain hero has no bottom padding and relies on the next section's top padding, which here is painted in the tint, so the button looks pushed into the band (the same on mobile, where the full-width button touches the band).
findings.reference: The competitor leaves open white space under its title, lead and two black buttons before the next module starts.
findings.fix: In template.css give the plain hero's inner a bottom padding (.page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner, e.g. padding-bottom: calc(var(--section-space) / 2)), at least when the next block carries a background. This is the same template change the contact page review asked for.

findings.issue: splitMedia-1, splitMedia-2 and splitMedia-2-steps still share the same beige tint, so three tinted sections run one under the other instead of alternating. Because they share a background, the gaps are also uneven: the photo starts about 36px under splitMedia-1's last line, while the steps start about 100px under the photo (the same on mobile). The last review raised this and it is still unfixed.
findings.reference: The competitor alternates white sections with its single pink-tinted Sampling panel; no two tinted modules touch.
findings.fix: The template's background alternation should count splitMedia-1 and splitMedia-2 as neighbouring plain sections and set splitMedia-2 (with its steps) on white, so the run reads white / tint / white with the section spacing restored between them.

findings.issue: The heading beside the steps, 'How a typical order runs from brief to shipment.', is still set at body size and weight. It reads as a caption, smaller than the bold step titles next to it, not as a section heading (the same on mobile). The last review raised this and it is still unfixed.
findings.reference: The competitor's section headings ('MOQs', 'Sampling') are clearly larger than body text and their item titles, in a medium weight.
findings.fix: The template should fit the process list's heading to its own words at section-heading level, like the page's other H2s (weight 500). Set no font-size in reference.css.

findings.issue: The seven related-page tiles still run 4 + 3, and the short last row of three starts on the left instead of being centred under the full row. The last review raised this and it is still unfixed.
findings.reference: Site rule: a grid's own short last row is centred; the competitor has no short rows hanging to the left.
findings.fix: Centre the related grid's short last row in the template (e.g. a flex-wrap row with justify-content: center and a fixed tile basis), as for other card grids.

findings.issue: owner-testimonials and related, two neighbouring plain sections, are both white, so the white / tint alternation stops for two sections before the tinted FAQ (the same on mobile).
findings.reference: The competitor never sets two text modules of the same background in a row without a visual break; the site rule alternates white and tinted plain sections.
findings.fix: The template's alternation should count related as a plain section after owner-testimonials and tint it through --section-tint, or move the tint so that testimonials / related / faq / cta alternate.

findings.issue: The intro paragraphs still run about 800px wide, roughly 95–100 characters a line, well past the ~70ch measure; the cta copy is just as wide. The last review raised this and it is still unfixed.
findings.reference: treatment-practice.md holds running text to about 70ch.
findings.fix: In reference.css give the intro's and cta's text column (.block--intro and .block--cta paragraph container) a max-width of about 70ch, starting on the heading's left edge.
